name: hasPDF_of_pdf_ne_zero
statement: MeasurableSpace Ω} {ℙ : Measure Ω} {μ : Measure E} {X : Ω → E} (hac : map X ℙ ≪ μ) (hpdf : ¬pdf X ℙ μ =ᵐ[μ] 0) : HasPDF X ℙ μ

name: quasiMeasurePreserving_hasPDF

name: indepFun_iff_pdf_prod_eq_pdf_mul_pdf
